description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named LeaveRequestDatesDetail within the OrangeHRM leave request plugin. It encapsulates details such as start and end dates, duration type, and specific start and end times related to a leave request.

classes.name: LeaveRequestDatesDetail
classes.description: A DTO class for holding details about leave request dates, including from and to dates, duration type, and optional start/end times.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing fromDate and optional toDate.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the leave request.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the start date of the leave request.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the leave request, if set.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the end date of the leave request.

methods.name: getDurationTypeId
methods.description: Returns the ID for the type of leave duration.

methods.name: setDurationTypeId
methods.description: Sets the ID for the type of leave duration.

methods.name: getDurationType
methods.description: Returns the description of the duration type.

methods.name: setDurationType
methods.description: Sets the description of the duration type.

methods.name: getStartTime
methods.description: Returns the start time of the leave period, if set.

methods.name: setStartTime
methods.description: Sets the start time of the leave period.

methods.name: getEndTime
methods.description: Returns the end time of the leave period, if set.

methods.name: setEndTime
methods.description: Sets the end time of the leave period.
